question: Which of the following oceans is located to the east of North America and South America?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atlantic Ocean**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atlantic Ocean** is the ocean that is located to the east of North America and South America.
 
• The Atlantic Ocean is the second-largest of the world's oceans, covering approximately 20% of Earth's surface.
 
• It separates the "Old World" from the "New World" and has been a critical route for exploration, trade, and travel.
 
• It connects to the Arctic Ocean in the north and the Southern Ocean in the south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pacific Ocean** is located to the west of North and South America and is the largest ocean on Earth.
 
• The **Indian Ocean** lies to the east of Africa and south of Asia, bordered by the Arabian Peninsula and Australia.
 
• The **Arctic Ocean** is the smallest and shallowest of the world's five major oceans and is located around the Arctic Circle.
 
• Oceans play a crucial role in regulating the Earth's climate and are home to diverse marine ecosystems.
